title: Quadratic completion over the separable residue field of a geometric node
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and let $C$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], equidimensional of dimension one [def-weil-pure-dimension] (dimension as in [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]). Let $x$ be a closed point with residue field $\kappa=\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] finite separable over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Suppose that, for an algebraic closure $\bar k/k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and a point $\bar x$ of $C\times_k\bar k$ over $x$ [def-pc-fibre-product], the completed local ring is isomorphic as a ring to $\bar k[[u,v]]/(uv)$. Put $A=\mathcal O_{C,x}$ and $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m_x$. Then $A$ is reduced (has no nonzero nilpotent elements), Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], essentially of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra], and of Krull dimension one [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. There exist a $k$-algebra section $\kappa\to\widehat A$ of the residue map, elements $a,b,c\in\kappa$ with $b^2-4ac\ne0$, and a continuous $\kappa$-algebra isomorphism
$$\widehat A\cong\kappa[[X,Y]]/(aX^2+bXY+cY^2),$$
inducing the identity on the residue field. Here $\widehat A=\varprojlim_n A/\mathfrak m^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]; the power series topology has the powers of the variable ideal as neighbourhoods of zero [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Quotients and algebra maps use [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient].

source.place: Tags 0C4D (lemma-nodal), equivalence (3) with (2), and 0C49 (lemma-nodal-algebraic), condition (3) and the coefficient-field choice in its proof; the local algebra is the local ring of an algebraic curve.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-separable-curve-geometric-local-data] with $d=1$, $K=\bar k$ and $y=\bar x$. Choose its $U=\operatorname{Spec}S$, $\mathfrak p$, $\mathfrak q$ and $\iota:\kappa\hookrightarrow K$. The germ maps identify $A=S_{\mathfrak p}$, $\kappa=S/\mathfrak p$ over $k$, and the stalk at $\bar x$ with $B=(S\otimes_kK)_{\mathfrak q}$, $\mathfrak q=\ker(s\otimes\lambda\mapsto\iota(\bar s)\lambda)$, including completions. So the assumed ring isomorphism is $\widehat B\cong K[[u,v]]/(uv)$. The node also gives Noetherianity, essential finite type and $\dim A=1$.

source.place: Tag 0C4D (lemma-nodal), affine-neighbourhood and geometric-stalk reduction; varieties.tex Tag 0A21 (lemma-dimension-locally-algebraic).

proof.text: $R=S\otimes_kK$ is a finitely generated $K$-algebra and $R/\mathfrak q=K$ via the structure map (step 1). By [lem-trf-geometric-node-fitting-depth] the ring isomorphism of step 1 gives $\operatorname{Fit}_1(\Omega_{R/K})B=\mathfrak n$ and $\operatorname{depth}B=1$.

source.place: Tag 0C4D (lemma-nodal), algebraically closed case via Tag 0C4C (lemma-fitting-ideal).

proof.text: Since $s\in\mathfrak p$ gives $\iota(\bar s)=0$, $\mathfrak q$ lies over $\mathfrak p$. With $\Omega=K$, [lem-trf-geometric-fitting-depth-descent] turns step 2 into $\operatorname{Fit}_1(\Omega_{S/k})A=\mathfrak m$ and $\operatorname{depth}A=1$.

source.place: Tag 0C4D (lemma-nodal), arbitrary-field paragraph: Fitting ideal and depth descend along the faithfully flat map.

proof.text: As $\kappa/k$ is finite separable, step 3 gives the hypotheses of [lem-trf-depth-fitting-quadratic-lci]. It supplies a $k$-algebra section $\kappa\to\widehat A$ of the residue map, $a,b,c\in\kappa$ with $b^2-4ac\ne0$, and a continuous isomorphism of complete local $\kappa$-algebras $\widehat A\cong\kappa[[X,Y]]/(aX^2+bXY+cY^2)$ inducing the identity on $\kappa$, transported to $\mathcal O_{C,x}$ through the germ identification of step 1.

source.place: Tag 0C4D (lemma-nodal), (5)=>(2), and Tag 0C49 (lemma-nodal-algebraic), quadratic form over the residue field.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-split-completion-local-invariant-descent](3) with $F=\kappa$, $K=\bar k$ and the $\iota,\mathfrak q$ of step 1, to the ring isomorphism of step 1: $A$ is reduced. With steps 1 and 4 this proves all assertions.
